content.text:
Updated the local defaults for SOL 6.1:

- **SOL 6.1 / high:** task leads, builders, reviewers, debugging, and performance work.
- **Luna / high:** bounded repository and history discovery.
- **Astra / low:** prose and synthesis; **high** for the hardest tasks.
- **Panels:** Astra, SOL 6.1, and Terra.

This follows [current OpenAI guidance](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models). High effort remains the migration baseline; lowering it needs representative comparisons.

Updated [PStack routing](/Users/staggart/.codex/worktrees/249d/agent-kit/plugins/pstack/models.json), agent profiles, and launch instructions. Bumped Engineering to **0.2.10** and PStack to **0.15.2**, with matching catalogs.

Validation, lint, type-check, and all **121 tests passed**.

Changes are local and unpublished. Installed profiles still need updating. Live RepoPrompt verification was unavailable because the app was not running.
